page: Amazon Web Services i7ie.xlarge is a storage-optimized instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8559C processor with 4 dedicated vCPUs (2 physical cores with hyper-threading) running at 3.2 GHz. The CPU is equipped with a 320 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for accelerated matrix operations. The instance is configured with 32.0 GB of high-speed DDR5 memory operating at 6 GHz, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core.

For storage-heavy workloads, the i7ie.xlarge includes 2500 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 4 Gbps. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included with this instance type.

Benchmark results indicate strong single-core capabilities, with Geekbench single-core scores reaching the top 10% tier and single-threaded gzip compression and bzip3 decompression performing in the top 25%. However, multi-core performance is more limited, with stress-ng multi-core and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression scoring in the bottom 25%. Memory read bandwidth also registers in the lower tier, though write bandwidth and database operations maintain average performance levels.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the instance offers high local storage density and DDR5 memory capacity relative to its 4 vCPUs, making it a viable option for storage-bound tasks without requiring larger compute footprints. It is well-suited for local databases, caching layers, text processing, and lightweight LLM inference tasks that benefit from fast local NVMe storage and strong single-thread performance.
